cohort: First 3 lexicographic libero_spatial HDF5 paths at pinned revision; demo_0 each; frames range(0,min(n,192),8); never select by timing or task success. Three public training demonstrations, at most 72 observations.
image_semantics: HDF5 opengl image convention required; official evaluation 180-degree rotation; original 128px demos, author JPEG/resize to224 and90% area crop; differs from256px online renders. State = ee_states6 + gripper_states2.
conditions: native: independent upstream OpenVLA-OFT code, same frozen checkpoint, once per observation
warmup: 3 first-observation forwards per condition/replay, then reset history before each chronological episode. Repeated calls use fresh input state copies.
runtime: Pinned Python3.10.14 image, torch2.2.0/BF16/custom pinned Transformers fork; explicitly SDPA for both sources; TF preprocessing CPU only. Native and FastVLA separate processes; no checkpoint code mutation. Upstream FastVLA synchronization/FLOP bookkeeping retained. No training.
timing: Wall duration includes original preprocess, transfer, policy, action unnormalization and gripper conversion; excludes disk reading/copy/logging. CUDA stream event span includes CPU launch gaps, not a kernel-time sum.
interpretation: Heuristic conservative go/no-go, not p-value or effect-size confirmation. A pass permits closed-loop protocol design only. A failure stops expansion of this first deployment, not a universal impossibility claim. No task success computed.
next_stage: Only after actual resources and triage pass, review closest prior work again and freeze independent closed-loop cohort/endpoints before outcomes. No automatic full study or paid compute.
